```plato
//==
// # Texturing
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Texturing
//  - Texture sampling and bindings

//==
// # Texturing
//
// The textures themselves: GPU-facing descriptors carrying name, dimensions,
// format, and mip count, and the procedural texture types that describe
// patterns evaluated at UV coordinates rather than stored texels. The pixel
// data itself lives in image types (Bitmap, FloatImage, MipChain,
// VolumeImage, CubemapImage); the interface the procedural types implement
// lives in `texturing.concepts.plato`; the sampling state and bindings used
// to read a texture follow in the next section.
// Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - UV origin (origin top-left, U right, V down).

//==
// ## Texture descriptors

// A 2D texture descriptor: dimensions, texel format, and mip count. A
// MipLevels of 0 requests a full chain down to 1x1. Pixel data lives in
// images (Bitmap, FloatImage, or MipChain), not in the descriptor.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Texture_mapping)
type Texture2D
    implements IValue
{
    Name: String;
    Size: IntegerSize2D;
    Format: PixelFormat;
    MipLevels: Integer;
}

// A 3D (volume) texture descriptor. Pixel data lives in a VolumeImage or an
// equivalent layer stack. A MipLevels of 0 requests a full chain.
type Texture3D
    implements IValue
{
    Name: String;
    Size: IntegerSize3D;
    Format: PixelFormat;
    MipLevels: Integer;
}

// A cubemap descriptor: six square faces of FaceSize texels per side. Pixel
// data lives in a CubemapImage. A MipLevels of 0 requests a full chain.
type TextureCube
    implements IValue
{
    Name: String;
    FaceSize: Integer;
    Format: PixelFormat;
    MipLevels: Integer;
}

// A 2D texture-array descriptor: LayerCount same-sized layers addressable by
// index in shaders.
type TextureArrayDescriptor
    implements IValue
{
    Name: String;
    Size: IntegerSize2D;
    LayerCount: Integer;
    Format: PixelFormat;
    MipLevels: Integer;
}

// How a cubemap or panorama is laid out when stored inside a single 2D image.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Equirectangular_projection)
type CubemapLayout
    = HorizontalCross | VerticalCross | HorizontalStrip | VerticalStrip | Equirectangular;

//==
// ## IProcedural textures

// A two-color checkerboard; Tiling is the number of A/B cell pairs across
// each UV axis. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Checkerboard)
type CheckerTexture
    implements IProceduralTexture
{
    ColorA: Color;
    ColorB: Color;
    Tiling: Number2;
}

// A linear gradient across UV space: the gradient ramp swept along the given
// direction angle (0 sweeps left to right).
type GradientTexture
    implements IProceduralTexture
{
    Gradient: ColorGradient;
    Angle: Angle;
}

// Fractal (fBm) noise: base Frequency in cycles per UV tile, Octaves layers
// with Lacunarity frequency growth and Gain amplitude falloff per octave,
// deterministically seeded.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fractional_Brownian_motion)
type NoiseTexture
    implements IProceduralTexture
{
    Frequency: Number;
    Octaves: Integer;
    Lacunarity: Number;
    Gain: Number;
    Seed: Integer;
}

// Triplanar projection settings: sample along each world axis and blend by
// surface normal. Higher BlendSharpness narrows the blend bands; Tiling
// scales the projected UVs.
type TriplanarProjection
    implements IValue
{
    BlendSharpness: Number;
    Tiling: Number2;
}

//==
// # Texture sampling and bindings
//
// How a texture is read rather than what it holds: wrap and filter state, the
// affine transform and projection applied to UV coordinates, the channel mask
// a consumer reads, and the binding that ties them to a descriptor. The
// texture descriptors and procedural textures themselves are the section above.

//==
// ## Sampling state

// How texture coordinates outside [0, 1] are handled along one axis.
type WrapMode
    = Repeat | ClampToEdge | MirroredRepeat | ClampToBorder | MirrorClampToEdge;

// How texels are filtered during sampling, including across mip levels;
// LinearMipLinear is trilinear.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Texture_filtering)
type FilterMode
    = Nearest
    | Linear
    | NearestMipNearest
    | LinearMipNearest
    | NearestMipLinear
    | LinearMipLinear
    | Anisotropic;
```
